title: Add one more cook

predict.q: From the 3rd cook onwards, marginal product falls. What happens to total product as cooks 3, 4 and 5 are added?

options.fb: Falling MP still adds output: the 4th cook adds 8 meals. TP falls only when MP is below zero.
TP stays flat only when MP is zero, at the 6th cook.

options.s: Total product keeps rising, but by less each time
Total product rises by more each time
options.fb: That is increasing marginal returns, seen only up to the 2nd cook.

task: Move the cooks slider from 1 to 6 and watch TP, MP and AP.

target.do: Move the cooks slider to 5 or 6, then press Check.

takeaway: Falling MP slows the rise of TP. TP falls only if MP turns negative.
explore: AP peaks at 12 (2–3 cooks), where MP crosses it. At 6 cooks MP = 0 and TP is flat.
